visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of the final cold dish, showing thinly sliced beef and bright green, roughly crushed cucumber chunks glistening with a savory sauce and sesame seeds. (2) A male cook wearing white disposable gloves and a light brown apron holds two fresh green cucumbers inside a clear plastic bag on a light-colored wooden table. (3) The cook uses the flat side of a silver kitchen knife to firmly smash the cucumbers through the bag, causing them to crack and split into irregular pieces. (4) White granulated sugar is poured into the bag from a small glass bowl. The cook then uses both hands to massage the bag, ensuring the sugar is distributed. (5) In a separate glass bowl, thin slices of red raw beef are shown. The cook adds white starch powder and liquid seasonings, then mixes the meat thoroughly by hand. (6) The seasoned beef slices are dropped into a pan of boiling water on an induction stove. Steam rises as the meat is stirred with tongs until it turns grey-brown. (7) The cooked beef is immediately transferred from the hot water into a glass bowl filled with ice cubes and water to stop the cooking process. (8) Clear cooking oil is poured into a clean black pan. Chopped white onions, minced ginger, and garlic are added and stirred using wooden chopsticks. (9) Red chili flakes and white sesame seeds are sprinkled into the pan. This is followed by pouring in dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and more sugar from individual glass containers. (10) Fresh lemon juice is added to the pan. The finished warm aromatic sauce is then poured over the blanched beef and smashed cucumbers in a large glass bowl and mixed.

The narrator continues to speak with clear articulation and moderate pitch variability, explaining the smashing technique. (3) The sound of crinkling plastic follows as the bag is shaken and massaged. The BGM remains constant in volume and intensity. The narrator details the addition of sugar for the marinade. (4) A soft splash sound occurs as liquid seasonings are added to the beef bowl. The narrator's tone remains professional and instructional. The guitar-driven music maintains the energetic mood of the tutorial. (5) The bubbling and hissing of boiling water becomes prominent as the beef is blanched. The narrator emphasizes the importance of turning off the heat, his voice slightly rising in pitch for emphasis. (6) A distinct splash and the clinking of ice cubes are heard as the beef hits the cold water. The background music's beat remains synchronized with the fast-paced editing of the video. (7) A loud sizzle erupts as oil and aromatics are tossed into the pan. The narrator lists the ingredients quickly, matching the high-density visual information with rapid but clear speech delivery. (8) Metallic clinking sounds are heard as seasonings are stirred in the pan. The narrator provides final instructions. The BGM reaches a steady state before the video ends with a closing remark.
